stops.note: madness, from para- (beside, beyond) and noos (mind)
Hippocrates used Greek 'paranoia' for madness; Kraepelin defined its modern sense around 1900
stops.meaning: a psychiatric condition of irrational suspicion

stops.note: settled as the English word for extreme, irrational distrust of others

current_meaning: an irrational and persistent feeling that people are threatening or plotting against you
